title: Hosea 3
paragraphs: ¹ The LORD said to me, "Go again, love a woman who is loved by another man and is an adulteress — love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes." ² So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley. ³ Then I told her, "You are to live with me for many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you." ⁴ For the Israelites will live for many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods. ⁵ Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
